target: AArch64 Linux EL0 on Apple ARM64; ARMv8-A integer, FP and Advanced SIMD baseline
coverage_rule: A passing corpus form proves only the tested encoding, operands and observed state. A family stays partial until all allocated baseline forms and reserved-encoding checks are covered.

domains.name: integer
remaining: all allocated encodings and reserved-field validation

domains.name: memory
remaining: register wrapping and all post-index forms

domains.name: exclusive
tested: single-register exclusive operations through threaded guest regression

domains.name: floating
tested: rounding and FPSR with six FPCR modes
scalar fixed-point SCVTF/UCVTF/FCVTZS/FCVTZU, all legal fractional immediates
remaining: scalar reciprocal estimates and refinement variants
domains.host_requirement: Current FP backend uses statically assembled AArch64 instructions; unavailable on non-AArch64 hosts.

domains.name: advanced-simd-integer
remaining: all shift immediates and scalar narrowing/copy combinations

domains.name: system
remaining: reserved encodings and consistent guest counter origin

domains.name: optional-extensions
domains.note: Architecturally defined no-extension behavior is used for selected PAuth HINTs; this does not implement PAuth.

linux_gaps.detail: Signal actions/masks are retained; non-PI robust owner-death recovery is implemented. Signal delivery, rt_sigreturn and PI robust mutexes remain incomplete.
dup/dup3/fcntl share open-description state, eventfd and epoll objects; descriptor flags are separate. Epoll watch open-description lifetime and close/reuse remain incomplete.

Futex, epoll, guest pipes and eventfd wait through the scheduler. Guest pipe SIGPIPE is isolated from the host. Inherited stream, large/vector I/O and signal interruption semantics need broader coverage.
Validate combined read/write oneshot, edge/rearm, descriptor close/reuse and temporary signal masks.
When all tasks wait indefinitely the synchronous run API can wait indefinitely; cancellation/wall-time policy is not yet implemented.
File-backed MAP_SHARED writeback, madvise and full procfs views are incomplete.
Sockets/network, process fork/exec/wait and terminal semantics are incomplete; current passing Python scripts do not prove a complete Linux environment.
Guest tasks currently use one host executor with a preserved 4096-instruction scheduling quantum. Functional concurrency does not establish physical multicore execution or high performance.
